verdict.rationale: RudderStack's compliance page says customers can store data on their own infrastructure and that multi-region businesses can process data in the US, EU, or both. This is reinforced by the self-hostable open-source data and control planes and by warehouse-native storage in the customer's own warehouse. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how to select or configure a region (e.g., EU data-plane setup steps, which plans include it), regions beyond US/EU, independent or hands-on corroboration of residency guarantees.
